title: Sequencing: witness sessions
bodyMd:
Five fictional interview sessions occur in five time slots, with one session per slot.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are North, South, East, West, Central.

- South must be in position 4.
- North must precede East.
- West must be immediately followed by Central.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.

provenance.notes: Original fictional scenario written for this expansion, not adapted from an official question.
